nary_nodes.label: Microsoft layoffs and Xbox restructure
evidence: Microsoft has announced it has cut 4,800 jobs - roughly 2.1% of its workforce - with Xbox to bear a large number of its latest layoffs.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event in which a company reorganizes its structure, operations, or workforce, such as layoffs or division changes.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No existing schema.org event type specifically covers corporate restructuring

nary_nodes.label: Spin-off of four Xbox studios
evidence: Four Xbox game development studios - Compulsion Games, Double Fine Productions, Ninja Theory and Undead Lab - would also be spun off as part of the changes, she added.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event in which a game studio is separated from its parent company to become an independent entity.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org class captures the spin‑off of a studio

nary_nodes.label: Reduction of 1,600 Xbox roles
evidence: The sweeping layoffs will see more than 1,600 roles immediately axed at Xbox.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where a company reduces the number of positions or roles, typically through layoffs or restructuring.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Existing schema.org event types do not represent job‑reduction actions

nary_nodes.label: Coleman on focusing for customers
evidence: Amy Coleman, executive vice president at Microsoft, told employees in a memo that the tech giant needed to focus on areas that can deliver for customers amid a "fast-changing industry".

nary_nodes.label: Sharma on significant restructure
evidence: Asha Sharma, who recently took over as Xbox's chief executive, said in a note to staff it was "beginning the most significant restructure in Xbox history".

nary_nodes.label: Sharma on bigger future for Xbox
evidence: "These changes are about a bigger future for Xbox, not a smaller one," Sharma said in a note, shared on X.

nary_nodes.label: Pescatore on major reset
evidence: Tech analyst Paolo Pescatore told the BBC the changes indeed marked a "major reset" for the company, which has further trials ahead.

nary_nodes.label: Harding-Rolls on Xbox vision
evidence: Piers Harding-Rolls of Ampere Analysis said this restructuring "underlines Xbox's vision for its studios and content, which will be more heavily focused on the biggest IP and audiences".

nary_nodes.label: Double Fine gratitude
evidence: Double Fine, acquired by Microsoft in 2019, wrote on X that it was "thankful to everyone at Xbox for seven great years together".

nary_nodes.label: Compulsion support priority
evidence: "Our immediate priority is to support our team throughout this transition period," Compulsion said on X - adding it was confident in its future.

nary_nodes.label: Second reduction of 1,600 Xbox roles
evidence: Another 1,600 roles will be reduced from Xbox as a result.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where a company reduces the number of positions or roles, typically through layoffs or restructuring.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Existing schema.org event types do not represent job‑reduction actions
